**BOHJ18A1 - Behandling med infliximab** is a clinical procedure code utilized within the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease Database (DANIBD) to register treatments with infliximab, an anti-TNF biologic medication. As part of the national initiative to systematize and elevate IBD care in Denmark through cross-regional quality measurement and standardized coding, this specific identifier tracks the administration of infliximab within the broader therapeutic class of [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (BMSL).

Infliximab, recorded under the BOHJ18A1 code, has established itself as a cornerstone therapy for IBD patients in Denmark. During the reporting period from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, it was the most frequently administered BMSL treatment for both pediatric and adult populations [^src1]. Specifically, the code was linked to 239 unique children and adolescents—accounting for 66% of all BMSL treatments in that demographic—and to 3,754 unique adults, representing 37% of adult BMSL therapies [^src1]. 

The clinical dominance of this treatment code persisted into the subsequent evaluation cycle documented in the 2024 DANIBD report. Appendix tables monitoring quality indicators for biological and small molecule drugs reveal that BOHJ18A1 (infliximab) constituted 65% of all BMSL treatments among children and 43% among adults [^src2]. The raw registry data further illustrates the extensive application of this code across various patient cohorts, logging thousands of treatment instances and highlighting its central role in the clinical benchmarking and management of inflammatory bowel diseases nationwide [^src2].
